footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Red Rock: after $168M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.7% to $2.0B in 2025. Gross margin was 62.4%, versus 61.6% a year earlier, and operating income rose 5.1% to $597M, a 29.7% margin.
Net income rose 22.1% to $188M, or $3.12 per share. Operating cash flow was $610M and free cash flow $291M, versus $264M; Red Rock returned $200M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Red Rock Resorts, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
